**Status:** Photorealistic commercial garment studies (`SELECTED_INTERNAL`) with method-specific physical branding (`woven_label`, `sewn_patch`, `embroidery`, `print_transfer`, or `none`) generated by `scripts/composite_photoreal_assets.py`. Ready for final owner review prior to client presentation.

> **2026-10-19 Method-Specific Branding Update:** Per [`BRANDING_METHOD_AND_SCALE_CORRECTION_2026-10-19.md`](BRANDING_METHOD_AND_SCALE_CORRECTION_2026-10-19.md), `C01` (Corporate suiting), `IND03` (Industrial zipper & bar-tack macro), and `H02` (Multi-sector uniform rail) use clean unbranded masters (`method: none`). ## 2. Authentic Brand Identity Assets & Garment Flat Illustrations

- **Official Brand Marks (`public/images/logo/`):**
  - `q-workwear-original.png`, `q-workwear-red-transparent.png`, `q-workwear-white-transparent.png`: Original client lockups.
  - `q-mark-red.png` and `q-mark-white.png`: Isolated symbol-only Q emblems (`184×235`) used for site header/footer logos and garment branding composites where small text would be physically illegible.
- **Technical Garment Flat Illustrations (`src/components/garments/GarmentArtwork.tsx`):**
  - Implemented from the approved study `docs/approval-batch-2026-10-19/garment-flat-studies.svg` depicting four sector garment pairs (Tailored Blazer + Dress Shirt, Double-Breasted Chef Coat + Bib Apron, One-Piece Hi-Vis Coverall, Piqué Polo + 6-Panel Cap).
- **Typography (`public/fonts/`):**
  - Self-hosted Barlow Regular (400), Medium (500), and SemiBold (600) under the SIL Open Font License (`public/fonts/OFL.txt`).
